description: This file contains the implementation of the PDO class within the Opencart System Library for database interactions. It provides methods to connect to a MySQL database, execute queries, escape strings, get last insert ID, and check connection status.

classes.name: PDO
classes.description: A class that encapsulates PDO database connection and query execution logic specific to OpenCart's system library for database interactions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the MySQL database using provided hostname, username, password, database name, and optional port. Sets session time zone and SQL modes.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Prepares and executes an SQL statement, returning a result object or true/false based on the query type.

methods.name: escape
methods.description: Escapes a string for safe use in SQL by binding it as a parameter.

methods.name: countAffected
methods.description: Returns the number of rows affected by the last SQL statement.

methods.name: getLastId
methods.description: Retrieves the last inserted ID from the database connection.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the database connection is currently active.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Closes the database connection when the object is destroyed.
